limits: Cache suites parse actual workflow/action YAML and evaluate guards in a VM. No GitHub cache service, remote runner or native package build is executed locally.
Lookup-mode output is an explicit fixture input for downstream cache admission; the action shell that chooses auto lookup mode is not executed by this suite.
CI selection suite builds the real in-memory graph and selection using synthetic source inputs; it does not execute those snippets or launch TypeScript watchers/processes.
